stories.title: España gana a los penaltis, borda su segunda estrella y confirma que manda en el fútbol femenino

en.title: Spain wins on penalties, earns its second star and confirms it dominates women's football
en.summary: Spain's under-20 women's team defeated North Korea on penalties to win the World Cup, with goalkeeper Laia López making crucial saves. The victory avenged a previous loss to the same opponent in the 2024 under-17 World Cup final.

stories.title: Un avión de Delta que despegó de Barcelona aterriza de emergencia en Oporto tras detectarse humo en la cabina

en.title: A Delta plane that departed from Barcelona makes an emergency landing in Porto after smoke is detected in the cabin
en.summary: A Delta aircraft flying from Barcelona to Boston made an emergency landing in Porto on Sunday following the detection of smoke in the cabin.

stories.title: Laia López derriba la resistencia de Corea del Norte y recupera la corona del Mundial- sub20

en.title: Laia López overcomes North Korea's resistance and reclaims the under-20 World Cup crown
en.summary: Spain's under-20 women's team won the World Cup final against North Korea on penalties, with Real Madrid goalkeeper Laia López making two decisive saves during the shootout.

stories.title: Un avión de Barcelona con destino a Boston aterriza de urgencia en Oporto por humo en la cabina

en.title: A plane from Barcelona bound for Boston makes an emergency landing in Porto due to smoke in the cabin
en.summary: A Barcelona-to-Boston flight made an emergency landing in Porto after smoke was detected in the cabin. Some of the 296 passengers required medical assistance following the landing.

stories.title: España ajusta cuentas con Corea del Norte en los penaltis y logra su segundo Mundial sub-20

en.title: Spain settles accounts with North Korea on penalties and achieves its second under-20 World Cup
en.summary: Spain's women's football team defeated North Korea in a penalty shootout to win the under-20 World Cup, with the same players who lost to the North Koreans on penalties in the under-17 World Cup two years earlier.

stories.title: Un avión de Delta que había salido de Barcelona aterriza en Oporto por humo en la cabina

en.title: A Delta plane that departed from Barcelona lands in Porto due to cabin smoke
en.summary: A Delta aircraft operating the Barcelona-Boston route made an emergency landing in Porto after smoke was detected in the cabin, with some of its 296 passengers requiring medical assistance.

stories.title: España se proclama campeona del mundo sub-20 femenino y destrona a Corea del Norte en penaltis

en.title: Spain becomes under-20 women's world champion and dethrones North Korea on penalties
en.summary: Spain's women's team won the under-20 World Cup championship by defeating defending champion North Korea in a penalty shootout, with goalkeeper Laia López making two crucial saves.

stories.title: Suiza rechaza en referéndum una aplicación más estricta de su neutralidad

en.title: Switzerland rejects stricter interpretation of its neutrality in referendum
en.summary: Swiss voters rejected a proposal to amend the constitution and enforce stricter neutrality by excluding military alliances like NATO and prohibiting economic sanctions, with over 71 percent voting against it.

stories.title: El PP responsabiliza a Sánchez de la crisis de vivienda y Vox apunta a la inmigración: "Si en vez de Maricarmen fuera Morocarmen, tendría casa"

en.title: PP blames Sánchez for housing crisis while Vox points to immigration: "If instead of Maricarmen it were Morocarmen, she would have a house"
en.summary: The PP attributes housing crisis protests to government mismanagement, while Vox leader Abascal characterizes protesters occupying Sol square as government militias and links the housing shortage to immigration policy.

stories.title: Detenidos cinco hombres con explosivos cerca de una base británica utilizada por el ejército estadounidense: "Querían causar grandes daños"

en.title: Five men arrested with explosives near British base used by US military: "They wanted to cause major damage"
en.summary: Five men were detained near a British military base used by the US military while in possession of explosives. Trump stated that the suspects had been under US surveillance for an extended period.

stories.title: Sánchez apremia a los socios a apoyar el decreto de vivienda “por Maricarmen y los millones de españoles que sufren la crisis”

en.title: Sánchez urges coalition partners to support housing decree "for Maricarmen and millions of Spaniards suffering the crisis"
en.summary: Spanish President Sánchez pressured his coalition partners to support a housing decree, characterizing the vote as a humanitarian matter and stating he is working to approve it by Tuesday.

stories.title: La policía desaloja el asentamiento en la playa ceutí de Benítez, próxima a la desalinizadora

en.title: Police evict settlement at Ceuta's Benítez beach, near desalination plant
en.summary: Authorities relocated immigrants from a beach settlement to a nearby open area as suitable accommodation facilities remain unavailable.

stories.title: El 'decreto Maricarmen' no sirve al vulnerable

en.title: The 'Maricarmen decree' fails to help the vulnerable
en.summary: Critics argue that a political decree prioritizes property interests over addressing the needs of vulnerable populations.

stories.title: Bill Gates advierte que la IA sin control podría causar "1.000 millones de muertes"

en.title: Bill Gates warns that uncontrolled AI could cause "1 billion deaths"
en.summary: Microsoft's co-founder cautioned that artificial intelligence in the wrong hands could be powerful enough to trigger catastrophic events resulting in a billion deaths.

stories.title: Pedro Sánchez confirma que el Gobierno trabaja en un decreto sobre vivienda

en.title: Pedro Sánchez confirms that the Government is working on a housing decree
en.summary: The Spanish Government is preparing a Royal Decree on housing to present to the Cabinet next Tuesday.

stories.title: Cientos de personas acampan en Sol por la vivienda: "O cae el rentismo, o cae el Gobierno"

en.title: Hundreds camp at Sol over housing: "Either rentism falls, or the Government falls"
en.summary: Protesters established a camp in central Madrid following a demonstration against evictions, voicing demands related to housing policies.

stories.title: Cinco perfumes de hombre perfectos para usar en otoño

en.title: Five men's perfumes perfect for wearing in autumn
en.summary: A selection of fragrances combines fresh citrus notes with warmer woods and spices suited for the autumn season.
